reason: I already have a cron job calling claude -p that opens PRs, and it works well enough. A pre-alpha tool from one developer is not something I move my team's pipeline onto, and the free self-hosted version covers me anyway if I get curious.
objection: A looping or failed run burns our Max quota overnight and nobody sees it. I see nothing here about hard spend caps or loop limits, and one developer in pre-alpha means I am the one debugging it at 7am.
would_change_my_mind: Proof of hard per-run quota and retry caps that kill a looping agent and ping me, plus a few months of other teams running it without incidents.
